{
  "root_cause": "The modal's click listener uses event.target.closest to detect elements with the close trigger attribute. Because the backdrop overlay (which has data-micromodal-close) is an ancestor of the modal's interior, any click inside the modal—including on a checkbox—triggers closeModal, causing the dialog to close unexpectedly and preventing Space from toggling the checkbox.",
  "repair_strategy": "Modify the click handler to close the modal only when the click target itself possesses the close trigger attribute (i.e., the backdrop or explicit close buttons), using hasAttribute instead of closest. This preserves closing via the backdrop and close buttons while preventing accidental closure when interacting with internal controls.",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "lib/src/index.js",
      "sha256": "0db2038c36c8c8c4730018c0ea419249e45923efa8315729f12b4d8da0d5fa2c",
      "before": "    onClick (event) {\n      if (event.target.closest(`[${ this.config.closeTrigger }]`)) {\n        event.preventDefault()\n        event.stopPropagation()\n        this.closeModal(event)\n      }\n    }",
      "after": "    onClick (event) {\n      if (event.target.hasAttribute(this.config.closeTrigger)) {\n        event.preventDefault()\n        event.stopPropagation()\n        this.closeModal(event)\n      }\n    }"
    }
  ],
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Pressing Space on a checkbox inside the preferences dialog will toggle the checkbox without closing the dialog, allowing users to adjust settings while the dialog remains open, satisfying the requirement that the dialog stays open after interacting with its controls.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "Altering the click handler could theoretically affect closing via the backdrop or close buttons, but those elements retain the close trigger attribute, so they will continue to close the modal.",
    "If any internal element is incorrectly assigned the close trigger attribute, it would unintentionally close the modal; developers should avoid adding that attribute to interactive interior elements."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Confirm that clicking the backdrop (overlay) closes the modal.",
    "Confirm that clicking the close button (×) or the Done button closes the modal.",
    "Confirm that pressing Space on the weekly or product offers checkbox toggles its state and does not close the modal.",
    "Confirm that after closing via the backdrop, close button, or Done button, focus returns to the Newsletter preferences button.",
    "Confirm that keyboard navigation (Tab) inside the modal continues to cycle through focusable elements as expected."
  ]
}
